# TikSaveHub

> Free online video downloader for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, and X (Twitter). Downloads videos without watermarks, extracts audio as MP3. No app installation required. Works in any browser on iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac, and Linux.

TikSaveHub processes all downloads server-side. No user data is stored. Supports 7 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese.

## TikTok

- [TikTok Video Downloader](https://tiksavehub.com/tiktok-video-downloader-without-watermark): Download TikTok videos without watermark as MP4 files up to 1080p HD
- [TikTok to MP3](https://tiksavehub.com/tiktok-to-mp3): Extract audio from TikTok videos as MP3 files

## Instagram

- [Instagram Video Downloader](https://tiksavehub.com/instagram-video-downloader-without-watermark): Download Instagram videos without watermark
- [Instagram Reels Downloader](https://tiksavehub.com/instagram-reels-downloader-without-watermark): Save Instagram Reels in HD quality
- [Instagram Story Downloader](https://tiksavehub.com/instagram-story-downloader-without-watermark): Download Instagram Stories anonymously
- [Instagram Audio Downloader](https://tiksavehub.com/instagram-audio-downloader): Extract audio from Instagram Reels and videos as MP3

- [Facebook Reels Downloader](https://tiksavehub.com/facebook-reels-downloader): Save Facebook Reels without watermark
- [Facebook Story Downloader](https://tiksavehub.com/facebook-story-downloader): Download Facebook Stories anonymously
- [Facebook Photo Downloader](https://tiksavehub.com/facebook-photo-downloader): Download Facebook photos and albums in full resolution
- [Facebook to MP3](https://tiksavehub.com/facebook-to-mp3): Extract audio from Facebook videos as MP3 files
